definitions.explanation: Traditional cast-iron ware made in Iwate Prefecture, mainly around Morioka and Oshu, best known for its heavy iron kettles.

examples.japanese: {南部鉄器|なんぶてっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鉄瓶|てつびん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a Nanbu iron kettle.

examples.japanese: {南部鉄器|なんぶてっき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{岩手県|いわてけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伝統工芸品|でんとうこうげいひん}だ。
examples.english: Nanbu ironware is a traditional craft of Iwate Prefecture.

examples.japanese: {南部鉄器|なんぶてっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{急須|きゅうす}→急須：04980_kyuusu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、⟦カラフル→カラフル：10803_karafuru⟧なもの⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Nanbu iron teapots are popular abroad too, and colorful ones are also made.

notes:
Named after the ⟦{南部|なんぶ}→南部：31707_nanbu⟧ clan, whose domain covered much of present-day ⟦{岩手|いわて}→岩手：32677_iwate⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {南部鉄器|なんぶてっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鉄瓶|てつびん}: Nanbu iron kettle (for boiling water)
- {南部鉄器|なんぶてっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{急須|きゅうす}→急須：04980_kyuusu⟧: Nanbu iron teapot (enamelled inside, for brewing tea)
- {南部鉄器|なんぶてっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧: Nanbu iron pot

CULTURAL NOTE:
Water boiled in an iron kettle is said to taste milder and to take up a little iron, which is part of the kettles' appeal.
